about_the_game:
You run the warehouse now.
The boss is on vacation, calling in from a beach chair while you’re keeping the place alive.

In Parcel Frenzy, you’ve got one goal: keep the operation running. Sort packages by weight, stack pallets under 60kg, label them, seal them, and ship them out. If you mess it up, you get fined. If you go bankrupt, you’re fired.

You control every step. Sort boxes onto conveyors based on their weight in KG. Wrong sorting leads to hefty fines. After sorting, rotate packages manually to fit them on a pallet before sealing. Manage electricity so your conveyors and scanners don’t blow the bill. Machines can break. your forklift and printer might even explode. Your boss refuses to invest in better tech. Why would he? This junk still gets the job done.

When machines break you have to repair them, which comes at a cost!, Don’t leave everything running all day.

Your shift runs from 08:00 to 22:00.

It’s fast. It’s messy. And once you get in the flow, it’s hard to stop. 

The Haunted Shift!

Step out of the warehouse and into a cursed graveyard, where all the past workers are now restless ghosts. Here, the job changes, you’re fulfilling ghost orders and loading the right items into coffins to keep them satisfied. Need more supplies? Order a fresh coffin packed with loot. Leave an order waiting too long or cancel it, and your reputation will take a big hit. Only the bravest can survive long enough to reach 10,000 Rep and unlock the Spooktacular Service achievement. Global leaderboards included!

Seasonal Themes

Unlock Halloween and Christmas themes to completely change the look and feel of the warehouse. Each theme comes with its own decorations, atmosphere, and radio music to set the mood. these are unlocked by playing in October / December in any year (for free) and can always be activated after unlock.

Build System

Decorate the warehouse with 50 items, including 17 seasonal unlocks. Place chairs, benches, plants, barrels, and more to shape the space how you like it. Every item you place is persistent and will remain in your warehouse across all sessions, even if you go bankrupt.

Speed Sorting minigame + Leaderboard

Boxes fly down the belt faster than the boss can yell. the boss screams either LEFT, MIDDLE, or RIGHT. Grab, throw, and sort them into the right holes before they drop. Every correct throw earns points, the more you miss, the earier your run is over. The pace keeps climbing until you break.

Set your best score and compete on the global SpeedSort Leaderboards.

Key mechanics:

  • Grab Packages & Pallets by hand, and rotate them however you like.

  • Sort packages correctly based on KG or pay a fine.

  • Fit boxes onto pallets manually and stay under the 60kg limit.

  • Seal and label pallets before shipping.

  • Balance electricity costs and turn machines on only when needed

  • Machines can break mid shift creating time pressure in certain cases.

Can you ship enough packages to keep the company afloat?

Multiple Graphical styles

Note from the Developer:

This is my first attempt at making a small-scale simulator. There isn’t a ton of customization and you don’t build your own workplace in this game. You are the worker, operating under your boss’s control.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD / Intel CPU running at 2.8 GHz or higher (AMD Phenom II X4 925 or Intel i3-4130 or newer are recommended)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD/NVIDIA graphic card, with at least 2GB of dedicated VRAM and with at least DirectX 11 and Shader Model 5.1 support: AMD Radeon HD 7870 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or newer is recommended.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD / Intel processor running at 3.5 GHz or higher (AMD FX-6300 series or Intel Core i3-8100 or newer is recommended).
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD/NVIDIA dedicated graphic card, with at least 4GB of dedicated VRAM (or more) and with at least DirectX 11 and Shader Model 5.1 support: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon R9
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2500 MB available space

short_description: Run the warehouse while your boss relaxes on a beach. Sort packages by weight, stack pallets under 60kg, label them, manage power, and deal with failing machines. Everything costs money. Mess up and you’re fined. Keep it running, or the company goes under.
